name: spa-recon
description: Recognises single-page apps — Vue/Nuxt, React/Next.js, Svelte/SvelteKit and Angular — and the bundler build behind them, then, on in-scope hosts, fetches any exposed JavaScript source maps and Vite build manifest to recover the app's source-file structure, its framework and build versions, and the URLs it references. When a source map carries the original source, it un-webpacks it automatically: the application's source files are written to the engagement's recovered files, the exposed-map finding links to them, and each recovered file is mined for the URLs it calls. Each discovery is recorded as a finding, and discovered hosts and URLs are added to the Entity Explorer. A right-click action, "Recover source from map", does the same on demand. It sends requests to the target to fetch .map and manifest.json files (active), so it is disabled until you enable it.

actions.label: Recover source from map
actions.description: Reconstruct the original source files this bundle's source map embeds, and mine every one for URLs and API endpoints into the Entity Explorer. Works on a JavaScript bundle (its .map is fetched) or on a .map response directly.

settings.label: Fetch exposed source maps
settings.description: When a bundle names a .map file (or one sits beside a module asset), fetch it from the target, and record the app source files and versions it reveals. Off: source maps are not requested.

settings.label: Look for Vite's build manifest
settings.description: Request the usual build-manifest locations (.vite/manifest.json and the like) once per origin, and record the built files it lists. Off: the manifest is not requested.

settings.label: Add URLs found in source maps to the Explorer
settings.description: URLs referenced in a source map's content are added to the Entity Explorer (off-target hosts show under Targets → Related). Capped per map.

settings.label: Un-webpack exposed source maps automatically
settings.description: When an exposed source map carries the original source (sourcesContent), reconstruct the application's own source files to the engagement's recovered files, link the exposed-map finding to them, and mine each one for the URLs it calls. Off: the map is still recorded as a finding, but its source is recovered only when you run the "Recover source from map" action.

settings.label: Record bundled dependencies as findings
settings.description: Record every dependency (and its version) a map's node_modules paths reveal as a Technology Version finding. The dependencies' own source is not written to disk, so the finding is where that fact is kept.

settings.label: Most dependency findings per source map
settings.description: A build with more node_modules dependencies than this records the first of them; raise it to record every one.

settings.label: Most URLs to take from one source map
Largest bundle read for a map reference (KiB)
Largest source map parsed (MiB)
settings.description: A map larger than this is recorded as exposed but not parsed, to stay within the plugin's time budget.
